column3: “Like gatherings of summer fruit” is rendered “Like the fruit pickers”; “my appetite craves” is rendered “which I crave.”
“The faithful” is rendered “The godly person,” and “bloods” “bloodshed”; “his brother” is rendered “the other.”
“The official” is rendered “The prince,” and “craving of himself” “desire of his soul”; NASB adds “together.”
“Good person” is rendered “The best of them,” and “the day of your watchmen” “The day when you post a watchman.”
“Believe” is rendered “trust,” and “trust” “have confidence”; “the openings of your mouth” is rendered “your lips.”
“People of his household” is rendered “men of his own household.”
“Watch” is rendered “watch expectantly.”
“For I have fallen” is rendered “Though I fall,” and “for I sit” “Though I dwell.”
“Conduct my case” is rendered “pleads my case,” and “look on” “see.”
“She will become a trampling place” is rendered “she will be trampled down”; “now” is rendered “At that time.”
“It will be far, a boundary” is rendered “will your boundary be extended”; the meaning is uncertain.
“The River” is rendered “the Euphrates”; NASB supplies “Even.”
“On its inhabitants” is rendered “because of her inhabitants.”
“Rod” is rendered “scepter,” “inheritance” “possession,” and “garden-land” “fruitful field.”
“Show him” is rendered “show you,” and “wonders” “miracles.”
“Strength” is rendered “might.”
“Things which crawl” is rendered “reptiles”; “quake from their strongholds” is rendered “come trembling out of their fortresses.”
“Transgression” is rendered “rebellious act,” “inheritance” “possession,” and “covenant loyalty” “unchanging love.”
“He will return, he will have compassion” is rendered “He will again have compassion”; “subdue” is rendered “tread … under foot,” and NASB adds “Yes.”
“Faithfulness” is rendered “truth,” and “covenant loyalty” “unchanging love”; “fathers” is rendered “forefathers.”
